note_text: Return policy: items received with damage must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery to be eligible for a full refund via PIX.
Refund processing time: once a cancellation is approved, the amount is returned to the original payment method within 3 business days.
Delivery address changes are only accepted while the order is in Pending or Confirmed status; after it reaches Shipped, the change must be made directly with the carrier.
Orders with Cancelled status are a terminal state and cannot be reopened or reactivated by the system - a new order must be placed instead.
Standard delivery SLA: 5 to 10 business days depending on the destination region; delays beyond that window automatically trigger a customer notification.
Accepted payment methods: credit card (up to 12 installments), debit card, PIX, and bank slip (boleto) with a 3 business day clearance time.
If a payment fails at checkout, the order is held in Pending status for up to 24 hours before being automatically cancelled if payment is never completed.
Refund eligibility window: cancellation requests made more than 30 days after delivery are not eligible for a refund, except for manufacturing defects.
Order status can transition Pending to Confirmed or Cancelled; Confirmed to Shipped or Cancelled; Shipped to Delivered. Delivered and Cancelled are both terminal states.
Orders can be cancelled by the customer directly while in Pending or Confirmed status; once Shipped, cancellation requires contacting support for a return instead.
If an item arrives damaged, customers should keep the original packaging and submit photos through support before a replacement or refund is issued.
Tracking numbers are generated and emailed to the customer as soon as the order moves to Shipped status, typically within a few hours of dispatch.
A declined card is retried automatically once; if the retry also fails, the customer must update their payment method to complete the order.
Partial refunds are available for multi-item orders where only some items are returned - the refund amount is prorated to the returned items only.
Customers can view their full order history and current order status by logging into their account on the website, no phone call needed for basic status checks.
If a package shows no tracking movement for more than 5 days, support can open an investigation with the carrier on the customer's behalf.
There is no cancellation fee for orders cancelled before they reach Shipped status; orders cancelled after shipping may be subject to return shipping costs.
Boleto (bank slip) payments that remain unpaid after 3 business days cause the associated order to be automatically cancelled.
